name.ja: BB戦士411 黄蓋グフ&合体武装6種(乙)
name.en: BB Senshi 411 Huang Gai Gouf & 6 types of combined weapons (Otsu)

ja: • 「歴戦の老将軍」黄蓋グフが装いを新たに再キット化！
• 一部にメタリックグロスインジェクションが使用され、高級感のある本体色に変更されている！
• メタリック成形の合体武装6種（乙）が付属し、「典韋アッシマー 賈詡アシュタロン 攻城兵器セット＆合体武装6種（甲）」付属の（甲）と組み合わせることで12合体巨大武装を再現できる！
• パッケージイラストは新規描き起こし！
en: • "The veteran general" Hwang Gai Gouf has been re-kitted with a new look!
• Metallic gloss injection is used in some parts and the color of the main body has been changed to give it a luxurious feel!

• Metallic molded 6 types of combined weapons (Part 2) are included, and by combining them with the ``Dian Wei Assimar Jia Xu Ashtalon Siege Weapon Set & 6 types of combined weapons (Part 1)'' included (Part 1), you can recreate 12 combined huge weapons!
• The package illustration is newly drawn!

ja: 十一ノ甲　十一海甲×1
十二ノ盾　十二天盾×1
en: Five Blades Five Tiger Blades x 1
Eight Canes Eight School Canes x1
Eleven Sea Shells Eleven Sea Shells x 1
